steps.page_title: React Dashboard Project Inquiry — FreelanceHub

actions.text:
Hi Marcus —

Thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. This sounds like a project I’d be interested in. Based on your scope (real-time charts, REST API integration, RBAC, responsive design, dark mode) I can take this on and deliver within your ~4 week timeline. A few quick questions so I can prepare a detailed proposal:

• Could you share API documentation or a sample endpoint for the data feed (rate limits, websocket vs. polling)?
• Do you have an existing auth system (OAuth/JWT) you want me to integrate with, or should I design an auth flow?
• For realtime charts are you open to using alternatives to D3 (e.g., Recharts, Chart.js, or Visx) if they provide faster delivery? Any preference?
• Are there specific browser / device support requirements for the responsive build?

Budget-wise your $5k–$6k range is reasonable; I’ll provide a firm estimate once I review the API and confirm requirements. I’m available to hop on a 30–45 minute call to discuss details — I’m free next week on Tuesday or Thursday between 10:00–14:00 CT. Let me know a time that works for you, or share a calendar invite and I’ll confirm.

I follow FreelanceHub’s escrow flow for payments and prefer to finalize scope with a short written agreement before work begins. Looking forward to learning more.

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer / Full-Stack Developer
